messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — branch freeze in 2h for the v2.6 RC. Can folks do a final green-sweep on their PRs and make sure version bumps + changelog entries are in. If you need an exception, ping me now.

Sam: On it. I'll run a flaky-test sweep and triage any flakes I find. Posting results in 30m. :mag_right:

Zeynep: FYI my version bump PR (#4572) is blocked by a failing e2e that's flaky on CI. Log shows `timeout on user-flow.spec.ts`. Re-ran once, still failed.

CI Bot: Job queued: `e2e/user-flow` (build 2467). Rerun available via `/ci rerun 2467`. Status: queued on shared runners.

DevOps: Heads-up — shared runners are near capacity. If rerun times are long, tag PR with `release/priority` and I can move it to dedicated runners. Recommend using `/ci rerun --priority` for urgent RC jobs.

Sam: Thanks — I'll rerun with priority if it flakes again. Also will add a short note in the PR about the flake so release notes team sees it.

Jon: Quick question — for changelog collisions, do we prefer squashing into a single entry per module or keep separate entries and let release tooling auto-merge?

Maria: Prefer single coherent entry per section (e.g., Core, Runtime). If multiple people touch same section, coordinate a short merge commit. If you can't, tag me and I'll mediate.

Zeynep: Re-ran e2e with priority; it passed on the 2nd run. Marked the PR as ready and added the changelog snippet under `Runtime` per the template.

Sam: Flaky sweep results: found 3 flaky unit tests across infra and runtime, quarantined them with `@quarantine` label, opened tickets with stack traces: https://go/infra-flakes. Left comments on the PRs that depend on those tests.

Maria: Great. Two reminders: 1) bump the package.json version in the same PR as changelog or CI will reject it; 2) add `changelog: x.y.z` label so the release notes tool picks it up.

Jon: I'll handle merging changelog conflicts this round. If anyone expects to land anything after freeze, DM me with a justification and I'll evaluate.

DevOps: Moved three priority jobs to dedicated runners. Average rerun turnaround now ~5m. Ping me if you need more.

CI Bot: All required status checks green for branch `release/v2.6` at commit `a1b2c3d`. Pending manual approvals: 2.

Maria: OK folks — final 30m push. If you see a flaky that won't go green fast, quarantine and open a ticket, don't block the RC. :thumbsup:

Sam: Will do. Reporting back in 25.

Zeynep: LGTM, merging my PR now.

Jon: Merging changelog fixes. Good luck everyone. :rocket:
